meta.title: Reseller Intent demo
meta.description: Reseller Intent with the GoDaddy Reseller Store plugin, several widget pages and a month of sample analytics.
meta.author: ekamran

steps.code: <?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; update_option( 'rstore_pl_id', 487116 ); update_option( 'blogname', 'Reseller Intent Demo' ); $plans = array( array( 'cPanel Starter', '$3.99', '$5.99' ), array( 'cPanel Economy', '$7.99', '$9.99' ), array( 'cPanel Deluxe', '$12.99', '$14.99' ), array( 'Websites + Marketing Standard', '$6.99', '$9.99' ), array( 'Websites + Marketing Premium', '$13.99', '$19.99' ), ); foreach ( $plans as $plan ) { $pid = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'reseller_product', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_title' => $plan[0] ) ); update_post_meta( $pid, 'rstore_salePrice', $plan[1] ); update_post_meta( $pid, 'rstore_listPrice', $plan[2] ); } $widget = '<!-- wp:shortcode -->[rstore_domain_search]<!-- /wp:shortcode -->'; foreach ( array( 'Find a Domain', 'Hosting', 'Deals' ) as $title ) { wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_title' => $title, 'post_content' => $widget ) ); } global $wpdb; $table = $wpdb->prefix . 'rintent_events'; $now = strtotime( current_time( 'mysql' ) ); mt_srand( 11 ); $tlds = array( 'com', 'com', 'com', 'in', 'io', 'app', 'net', 'co', 'org', 'dev', 'store', 'ai', 'shop', 'online' ); $words = array( 'desibites', 'cloudkart', 'zaikaa', 'homelab', 'getfit', 'chaiwala', 'urbanest', 'pixelpit', 'swiftcart', 'bluepeak', 'greenmart', 'quickbite', 'crafthub', 'petcorner', 'gearbox' ); $codes = array( 'IN', 'IN', 'IN', 'US', 'US', 'GB', 'AE', 'DE', 'CA', 'PK', 'AU', 'SG' ); $devices = array( 'mobile', 'mobile', 'mobile', 'desktop', 'desktop', 'tablet' ); $paths = array( '/find-a-domain/', '/find-a-domain/', '/find-a-domain/', '/find-a-domain/', '/', '/', '/hosting/', '/hosting/', '/deals/' ); $repeat_pool = array(); for ( $i = 0; $i < 25; $i++ ) { $repeat_pool[] = $words[ $i % 15 ] . $i . '.' . $tlds[ $i % 14 ]; } $search_rows = array(); $cart_rows = array(); for ( $day = 0; $day < 190; $day++ ) { $per_day = $day < 30 ? mt_rand( 13, 19 ) : ( $day < 90 ? mt_rand( 8, 13 ) : mt_rand( 3, 7 ) ); for ( $k = 0; $k < $per_day; $k++ ) { $domain = ( 0 === $k % 3 ) ? $repeat_pool[ mt_rand( 0, 24 ) ] : $words[ mt_rand( 0, 14 ) ] . mt_rand( 10, 9999 ) . '.' . $tlds[ mt_rand( 0, 13 ) ]; $search_rows[] = $wpdb->prepare( '(%s,%s,1,%d,%s,%s,%s,%s)', 'domain_search', $domain, mt_rand( 0, 9 ) < 4 ? 1 : 0, $devices[ mt_rand( 0, 5 ) ], $codes[ mt_rand( 0, 11 ) ], home_url( $paths[ mt_rand( 0, 8 ) ] ), gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', $now - ( $day * 86400 ) - mt_rand( 0, 82800 ) ) ); } $carts = $day < 30 ? mt_rand( 0, 2 ) : ( $day < 90 ? mt_rand( 1, 3 ) : mt_rand( 0, 1 ) ); for ( $c = 0; $c < $carts; $c++ ) { $n = 1; $roll = mt_rand( 0, 9 ); if ( 7 === $roll || 8 === $roll ) { $n = 2; } elseif ( 9 === $roll ) { $n = mt_rand( 3, 5 ); } $items = array(); for ( $j = 0; $j < $n; $j++ ) { $items[] = $repeat_pool[ mt_rand( 0, 24 ) ]; } $cart_rows[] = $wpdb->prepare( '(%s,%s,1,%d,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)', 'continue_to_cart', $items[0], $n, wp_json_encode( $items ), $devices[ mt_rand( 0, 5 ) ], $codes[ mt_rand( 0, 11 ) ], home_url( $paths[ mt_rand( 0, 8 ) ] ), gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', $now - ( $day * 86400 ) - mt_rand( 0, 82800 ) ) ); } } foreach ( array_chunk( $search_rows, 100 ) as $chunk ) { $wpdb->query( "INSERT INTO {$table} (event_type,domain_query,event_count,is_available,device,country,page_url,created_at) VALUES " . implode( ',', $chunk ) ); } foreach ( array_chunk( $cart_rows, 100 ) as $chunk ) { $wpdb->query( "INSERT INTO {$table} (event_type,domain_query,event_count,items_count,items_json,device,country,page_url,created_at) VALUES " . implode( ',', $chunk ) ); }
